item.title: Metro Board Recertifies Environmental Documents for Gondola Proposal

item.description: The first certificate of occupancy was issued Friday for a West Altadena home fully rebuilt after the devastating Eaton Fire. item.title: LA Council Tentatively Approves Updated Rent Stabilization Ordinance
item.description: The Los Angeles City Council tentatively approved an ordinance Friday updating regulations governing rent control for apartments built on or before Oct. 1, 1978. In a 9-2 vote, council members approved a new ordinance establishing a new formula to set annual allowable increases for roughly 650,000 rental units, calculating 90% of the Consumer Price Index.
